collector.registration: engine/src/state-sources.mjs registers the public WVABCA Liquor Search recent-purchase route and current barrel-selection page, while the collector adds the reviewed active-license directory as searchable, directory-only premises.

storeIdentity.proof: Directory premises remain bound to active ABCA license identities. Recent-purchase rows use WVABCA's own StoreNumber, DBA, street, city, and phone as exact source identity; directory linkage is optional and never fabricated when legal-name or address forms differ.

sourceSemantics.availability: WVABCA Liquor Search proves that an exact retailer purchased a named product within the trailing three-month window. It publishes no purchase date, quantity, current shelf stock, pickup, or delivery. Barrel selections remain statewide ordering intelligence only.

stateFilter.assertion: Lifecycle-backed state controls expose West Virginia only after promotion evidence activates the state.

areaFilter.reason: Recent-purchase rows identify exact stores and cities, but the release does not add a separate customer area taxonomy.

preferences.assertion: Lifecycle-backed preference normalization retains the West Virginia state selection after promotion.

dashboard.assertion: The dashboard uses the same lifecycle-backed state option and non-inventory coverage summary.

dropFeedApi.assertion: The customer feed accepts the exact WV state filter and exposes exact-store recent-purchase leads plus official selection rows with explicit call-first, not-live-shelf-inventory caveats.

finder.assertion: The location export includes all 180 reviewed active ABCA license premises as searchable directory-only identities.

alerts.assertion: Lifecycle, canonicalization, export, and customer visibility keep every WV row false for inventory, watch, email, SMS, and delivery eligibility.

monitoring.assertion: The source report records exact-store purchase rows only when the runtime key, pinned product identities, start/end canaries, request budget, and response-shape checks pass. Missing, empty-throttled, collapsed, or malformed runs fail closed while the barrel parser remains independently isolated.

export.assertion: Export preserves exact-store purchase-window identities as on-site-only shipment leads, six official selection identities, and 180 directory premises without creating live inventory, quantity, watch, email, SMS, or delivery alerts.

shadow.reason: Three GitHub Actions shadow runs returned 186 signals, 180 directory-only exact premises, zero alert candidates, and no roadblocks.

canary.reason: Two isolated GitHub Actions canary runs exported six non-alertable official-selection cards while production publication and alert delivery stayed disabled.

production.assertion: This manifest does not claim production deployment.
production.reason: Production activation requires immutable promotion provenance, guarded merge, targeted refresh, and canonical verification.
